activity: set_power_activity -global and -input -activity ACT -duty 0.5 (transitions per cycle); clock nets toggle every cycle; ROM macros clocked every cycle (worst case: no CE gating credit). hd_tile = 4 x elemA + 1 x elemB hard cores (plan 674a8ac9); glue = tile - cores area

glue ASSUMPTION (no hd_tile glue netlist power): upper bound glue at the 5-core average W/mm2 (S81-HEAD ~1.07M cells/tile vs 0.658M in the cores -> glue ~0.41M cells, i.e. a full-density glue is plausible); lower bound glue 0 W

other head types (spine, stations, serdes digital strip, ctl/host/mesh/lep0N): no netlist -> charged at the hd_tile upper-bound density (ASSUMPTION, conservative); SerDes PHY windows 4.37 W/macro (S81-PHY-ASSUME)
